updates.note: Management reaffirmed the EBITDA margin range of 26% to 27% excluding interest income.
updates.quote: without interest income it should be somewhere around 26%-27%

updates.note: ROH revenue growth expectation revised down to 8% to 9%.
updates.quote: ROH, we expect the growth to be consistent in line with the past and it should be somewhere between 8% to 9% growth

updates.note: Reaffirmed consistent double-digit revenue growth from FY25 onwards.
updates.quote: we will be able to show a consistent double-digit growth

updates.note: Manufacturing growth expected to be around 15% to 18% every year.
updates.quote: manufacturing growth definitely it has to be around 15% to 18% growth has to be there every year.

new_promises.statement: Bring down manpower cost to 16% of revenue in the current financial year.
new_promises.quote: we expected to bring it down to further to 16% of revenue in the current financial year.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Estimate total CAPEX for the next 5 years to be between 14,000 to 15,000 crores.
new_promises.quote: the CAPEX plan for the next 5 years is estimated to be somewhere between 14,000 to 15,000 crores
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Expect outstanding order book to be around 1,20,000 crores by 31st March 2025.
new_promises.quote: we expect the outstanding order book position to be somewhere around 1,20,000 crores even after liquidation of the certain portion of order
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Make third line of LCA in Nashik operational from October of the current financial year.
new_promises.quote: third line is likely to become operational from October of the current financial year.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan
